title: OperationContracts
$comment: ADR-11: domain computation is exposed through a versioned, pre-registered operation. The operation id is declared by the industry pack, the implementation is chosen by the composition root, and no request may carry code or a package path.

OperationId.title: OperationId
OperationId.description: Namespaced operation id, e.g. home-energy.plan. At least one dot separates the declaring namespace from the operation name.

OperationVersion.title: OperationVersion
OperationVersion.description: Monotonic operation version, rendered as the digits after '@' (e.g. home-energy.plan@1).

RegisteredOperation.title: RegisteredOperation
RegisteredOperation.description: A compute operation that preflight has validated: required capabilities, input/output schema, read-only snapshot inputs, CPU budget and handler digest. Unregistered operations cannot be executed even when their parameters are well-formed.

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema for the operation's typed parameters. Validated before the handler runs.

OperationRegistry.title: OperationRegistry
OperationRegistry.description: The set of compute operations a deployment has registered. The registry is versioned and digested; adding an operation is a new registry version, never an in-place mutation.
